budget_policy: Implementation corrections and resolution/independent replays are recorded separately. Stop uninformative tuning. Reserve final third for independent validation and delivery.
B_input_contract: Binary STL vertices and triangles, millimetres, tolerances, discrete triangle partition labels, indexed corners and ordered edge chains, explicit smooth/feature seam declarations. No original CAD, UV, normals, control nets, XY map or CAD-assisted cache.
B_boundary_policy: Shared spline coefficients and consistent chain arclength parameters enforce C0 before sewing. Outer boundary approximation error is separate from interpatch gap. Feature sides keep separate mesh normals.
A_policy: CAD-assisted, original outer curves and their affine parameter correspondence retained. Same 4324-pole space for inverse-UV and mesh-UV 3D fits; differs from historical height-only objective and hence is a small attribution control, not a pure comparison to historical height fitting.
final_evaluation_policy: Original-CAD holdout used only after all B configurations are frozen. Fresh samples, no cached distances. Sampled maxima are not continuous bounds.
acceptance: All outputs DiagnosticOnly and can_apply=false until every applicable product and external CAD gate passes. Open regions are not capped.
